metadata.title: [BUG]: Initial Login Broken on v1.0.1 Docker Compose Deployment
metadata.author: jmatlock-fnts

description:
### 🐞 Bug Summary
Briefly describe the issue or unexpected behavior.
When installing v1.0.1 from scratch via docker compose and logging in as admin@example.com and changeme, the require password screen pops up, however even when meeting all of the password requirement it keeps saying that the password requirements are not met when clicking change password button.
---

### 🧩 Affected Component
Select the area of the project impacted:

- [ ] `mcpgateway` - API
- [ x ] `mcpgateway` - UI (admin panel)
- [ ] `mcpgateway.wrapper` - stdio wrapper
- [ ] Federation or Transports
- [ ] CLI, Makefiles, or shell scripts
- [ ] Container setup (Docker/Podman/Compose)
- [ ] Other (explain below)

---

### 🔁 Steps to Reproduce

1. ...git clone https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge.git
2. ...docker compose up -d
3. ...login into http://ipaddress:8080/admin as admin@example.com and try to change password on the require password screen when prompted.

---

### 🤔 Expected Behavior
What should have happened instead?
Password should have changed and logged into contextforge successfully as admin@example.com.  This was the behavior in v1.0.0.
